records.title: M3-T11-204 — Complementary pair primitive-leg product and fixed-edge fiber
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-204 — Complementary pair primitive-leg product and fixed-edge fiber


STATUS: PROVED_COMPLEMENTARY_PAIR_PRIMITIVE_LEG_PRODUCT / PROVED_HIDDEN_VISIBLE_MEDIAN_SQUARE_ROUTING / PROVED_GLOBAL_FIXED_PHYSICAL_EDGE_FIBER / PROVED_SUMMED_SMALL_EDGE_SECTOR / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
Authority: Stage37 MAIN, operational CARD-INDEX, short RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE only as needed, latest203, retained194/195 pair-phase results and174/176/186 content interfaces. Gate OPEN. NEXT205. Independent hostile audit NOT RUN; separate-chat audit162–185 scope unchanged. TI parked;120 retracted;147–149 frozen. No retraction.


1. Result and scope


203 decomposed the median content b into
b=b_Q*b_S,
with b_Q=gcd(b,q_phase) the phase-visible unitary component and b_S the full-S-hidden unitary component.


This card moves that split from the full triple-product denominator into the complementary TWO-direction pair phase.


Relabel the endpoint so h_i=b is the median content, and {j,k} are the other two directions. Use195's complementary signed pair phases


psi_+ = w_j/w_k,
psi_- = w_j/conj(w_k)=w_j*w_k,


with integer numerators


Q_+=e_j e_k+f_j f_k,
P_+=f_j e_k-e_j f_k,


Q_-=e_j e_k-f_j f_k,
P_-=f_j e_k+e_j f_k.                         (204.1)


Let


G_+=gcd(Q_+,P_+),   G_-=gcd(Q_-,P_-),
c_+=R^2/G_+,        c_-=R^2/G_-,


and primitive signed legs


q_+=Q_+/G_+, p_+=P_+/G_+,
q_-=Q_-/G_-, p_-=P_-/G_-.                    (204.2)


Retained195 proves


c_+ c_-=R^2.                                   (204.3)


The new exact numerator products are


q_+ q_- = -e_i^2,                              (204.4)
p_+ p_- = e_k^2-e_j^2.                         (204.5)


Equation(204.4) yields a new all-content fixed-edge fiber and a direct square routing of203's hidden/visible median blocks.


2. Complementary primitive-leg product


From the physical face identities


f_j^2=e_i^2+e_k^2,
f_k^2=e_i^2+e_j^2,
R^2=e_i^2+e_j^2+e_k^2,


we have


Q_+Q_-
= e_j^2 e_k^2-f_j^2 f_k^2
= -e_i^2 R^2.                                  (204.6)


Likewise


P_+P_-
= f_j^2 e_k^2-e_j^2 f_k^2
= R^2(e_k^2-e_j^2).                            (204.7)


Since(204.3) gives


G_+G_-
=R^4/(c_+c_-)
=R^2,                                           (204.8)


dividing(204.6),(204.7) by(204.8) proves(204.4),(204.5).


No local density or sign heuristic is used. These are exact integer identities on every retained physical endpoint.


3. Hidden/visible median square routing


Fix p^alpha||b=h_i, and put beta=v_p(tau), lambda=alpha+beta.


Because p divides only h_i, both j,k are p-unit-content directions. Their individual phase denominator depths are lambda,lambda. By195, the pair denominator exponents are {0,2lambda}.


203's triple-product rows have:
- visible rows(A)/(B): the j,k Gaussian orientations are the same;
- hidden row(C): the j,k orientations are opposite.


Therefore:


visible p:
v_p(c_+)=0, v_p(c_-)=2lambda;


hidden p:
v_p(c_+)=2lambda, v_p(c_-)=0.                 (204.9)


In a primitive Pythagorean pair-phase triangle, a prime dividing its hypotenuse cannot divide either primitive leg. Hence from q_+q_-=-e_i^2:


visible p => v_p(q_-)=0 and v_p(q_+)=2v_p(e_i)>=2alpha;
hidden p  => v_p(q_+)=0 and v_p(q_-)=2v_p(e_i)>=2alpha.  (204.10)


Multiplying over the unitary median split gives


b_Q^2 | q_+,
b_S^2 | q_-.                                    (204.11)


Define


r_+=q_+/b_Q^2,
r_-=q_-/b_S^2.                                  (204.12)


Since b_Q b_S=b and b|e_i,


r_+ r_- = -(e_i/b)^2.                           (204.13)


Thus the median content square is not merely hidden in Den(S): its visible and hidden blocks are separated into the two complementary primitive REAL legs of the pair phases. This is a new same-physical numerator receiver.


4. Uniform fixed physical-edge fiber


Fix a direction i and a positive physical edge value


e_i=E<=B.                                       (204.14)


By(204.4), q_+ is a nonzero integer divisor of E^2 and q_-=-E^2/q_+. Therefore the number of possible q_+ values is at most divisor-many:


#q_+ <= 2*d(E^2)=B^o.                          (204.15)


For a fixed nonzero q=q_+, the primitive pair phase satisfies


q^2+p^2=c^2,
gcd(q,p,c)=1.                                   (204.16)


Hence


(c-|p|)(c+|p|)=q^2.                             (204.17)


Positive divisor pairs of q^2 determine (|p|,c), with only bounded parity/sign choices. Thus a fixed q has B^o possible rational pair phases psi_+.


Retained194 proves that each fixed admissible pair phase psi_+=w_j/w_k has at most B^o primitive physical endpoint extensions, uniformly over all contents and R<=B.


Consequently


m_edge(E;B)
:= #{primitive canonical endpoints R<=B with specified direction edge e_i=E}
<= B^o, uniformly in E<=B.                     (204.18)


The direction label costs only three choices. This is an ALL-content physical endpoint fiber; no outer h/content packet is summed.


5. Summed small-edge sector


Let


e_min=min(e_1,e_2,e_3).


From(204.18), for every 1<=Z<=B,


#E(e_min<=Z) <= Z B^o.                         (204.19)


Hence for fixed epsilon_e>0,


Z=B^(1/3-epsilon_e)


gives


#E(e_min<=B^(1/3-epsilon_e))
= o(M3(B))                                     (204.20)


at the retained M3(B)>>B^(1/3) comparison scale.


This is a new scoped disposal. It is not a global endpoint upper bound and is not multiplied with200 small-W,171 small-Sigma,174 small-D_min,195 small-Phi or any other sector.


6. Why this is not already195


195 proves the complementary denominator laws


c_+c_-=R^2,
Phi_+Phi_-=kappa R


and fixed-Phi endpoint fibers. It does not record the primitive numerator products(204.4),(204.5), the median square split(204.11), or the fixed physical-edge fiber(204.18).


194's map contains a fixed pair phase -> B^o endpoint fiber. 204 uses that retained theorem only after the new exact factorization q_+q_-=-e_i^2 reduces a fixed physical edge to divisor-many pair phases.


Thus the new saving is not a second charge of the same fixed-phase fiber; it is a new finite reconstruction from a fixed physical edge into the already-counted phase coordinate.


7. Hidden branch interpretation


On a hidden median prime p^alpha||b_S, c_+ carries the full p^(2lambda) pair denominator while q_+ is a p-unit; the complementary primitive leg q_- carries at least p^(2alpha). Hence


b_S^2 | q_-                                    (204.21)


is the normalized pair-phase form of203's hidden full-S condition.


On visible primes the roles exchange and


b_Q^2 | q_+.                                   (204.22)


The quotients r_+,r_- multiply to the square of the reduced median-direction primitive edge u_i=e_i/b. Therefore future work can attack the remaining K>1 low-median population through a divisor factorization of u_i^2 while preserving the original pair phases, rather than through Den(S) alone.


No independence is claimed between q_+,q_-,b_Q,b_S or u_i.


8. No-double-charge rules


Do not:
- count b_Q^2|q_+ and b_S^2|q_- as two independent square probabilities;
- multiply the fixed-edge fiber with194 fixed-pair-phase or195 fixed-Phi fibers as independent gains;
- infer that fixed u_i=e_i/b has B^o fiber: b still moves and this is NOT proved here;
- convert small e_min and small W sectors into a product saving;
- treat auxiliary psi_- as an additional physical selector; it is derived from the same physical endpoint.


9. NEXT205


Work on the residual after the new small-edge sector:


e_i > B^(1/3-epsilon_e) for all three physical edges,


together with171 large-Sigma,174 large-D_min and the K>1 low-median conditions.


For the median direction i write


u_i=e_i/b,
q_+=b_Q^2 r_+,
q_-=b_S^2 r_-,
r_+r_-=-u_i^2.                                 (204.23)


If the low-median branch has b<=K, then the small-edge disposal forces


u_i > B^(1/3-epsilon_e)/K.                     (204.24)


NEXT205 should seek a summed physical bound from the factorization r_+r_-=-u_i^2 together with the TWO primitive pair-phase triangles and195 complementary denominators. A productive theorem must pay moving b_Q,b_S and u_i on one endpoint; fixed-u_i B^o is not available.


If this only reparameterizes the same divisor support, record the firewall and return to the separate large-c threshold branch. Do not restart K1-only177–181 or134-superseded fresh C_u/G.


Gate OPEN; global credit0. Physical endpoints enumerated=0.


10. Verification and audit scope


(204.6),(204.7) are direct polynomial identities from the three physical face equations and the sphere equation. (204.8) is retained195. The fixed-edge count uses only elementary divisor reconstruction of the primitive norm-one triangle and retained194's fixed-pair-phase fiber.


Targeted CARD-INDEX searches for fixed physical edge, q_+q_-, complementary numerator product and small-edge sector found no indexed prior result of this form. Novelty is relative to the current Drive portfolio, not a literature-wide claim.


Within-session exact symbolic/deductive review PASS. Independent hostile audit NOT RUN. Separate-chat audit162–185 remains the only independent audit scope. No retraction, closure or global-credit flag change.

records.title: M3-T11-203 — Unitary content routing into phase and full-S denominators
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-203 — Unitary content routing into phase and full-S denominators


STATUS: PROVED_CONTENT_PHASE_UNITARY_ROUTER / PROVED_GCD_H_QPHASE_EQUALS_GCD_H_NT / PROVED_MEDIAN_TERNARY_DEPTH_LAW / SCOPED_VISIBLE_MEDIAN_QTAIL / HIDDEN_FULL_S_BRANCH_OPEN / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
Authority: Stage37 MAIN, operational CARD-INDEX, short RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE only for exact content identities, latest202, and retained171/174/176/186. Gate OPEN. NEXT204. Independent hostile audit NOT RUN; separate-chat audit162–185 scope unchanged. TI parked;120 retracted;147–149 frozen. No retraction.


1. Result and scope


202 closed the direct large-W/phase normalization route. Return to174–176's all-content low-median gate.


Retained content notation:
h_i=gcd(R,e_i), H=h_1 h_2 h_3, R=H*tau,
the h_i are pairwise coprime,
D_i=R/h_i=tau*c_i.
Sort the physical contents
a<=b<=d
with deterministic ties. Then174 gives exactly


q_min=a*tau,
D_min=q_min*b=a*b*tau,
R=q_min*b*d.                                    (203.1)


Here q_min is174's space/content quotient. It is NOT186's q_phase.


Retained186 gives


H*c_u*Den(S)=R^3,
Den(S)=D_S^2,
q_phase=R/D_S,
c_u=tau*q_phase^2.                              (203.2)


The new theorem is that every prime-power block of physical content is routed as a WHOLE block to q_phase or to D_S. Equivalently


H_Q:=gcd(H,q_phase)=gcd(H,|N_T|)
is a unitary divisor of H, and


H_S:=H/H_Q divides D_S.                         (203.3)


Hence


H_Q^2 | c_u,
H_S^2 | Den(S),
gcd(H_Q,H_S)=1.                                 (203.4)


For the median content b this yields an exact visible/hidden split


b_Q:=gcd(b,q_phase)=gcd(b,|N_T|) || b,
b_S:=b/b_Q,
b_S | D_S.                                      (203.5)


The symbol || means unitary divisor: gcd(b_Q,b/b_Q)=1.


This is a new same-physical bridge between174's moving median content and186's phase/full-S receiver. It does NOT yet give a global count; the b_S branch can hide the full content block in D_S.


2. Primewise derivation from the186 full-content table


Fix any odd prime p dividing H. Pairwise coprimality of the h_i means p belongs to exactly one content. Write


alpha=v_p(H)>0,
beta=v_p(tau)>=0,
lambda=v_p(R)=alpha+beta.                      (203.6)


If beta>0, this is186's partial-content case with kappa=alpha<lambda. Its three exact rows are


(A) v_p(c_u)=3lambda-alpha, v_p(Den(S))=0;
(B) v_p(c_u)=lambda+alpha, v_p(Den(S))=2(lambda-alpha);
(C) v_p(c_u)=lambda-alpha, v_p(Den(S))=2lambda.


Since Den(S)=D_S^2 and q_phase=R/D_S, these are exactly


(A) v_p(q_phase)=lambda, v_p(D_S)=0;
(B) v_p(q_phase)=alpha,  v_p(D_S)=beta;
(C) v_p(q_phase)=0,      v_p(D_S)=lambda.       (203.7)


If beta=0,186's saturated-content two rows are precisely the collapse of(A)/(B) versus(C):


v_p(q_phase)=alpha, v_p(D_S)=0,
or
v_p(q_phase)=0,     v_p(D_S)=alpha.             (203.8)


Thus in ALL cases


v_p(q_phase) is one of lambda, alpha, 0,         (203.9)


where lambda and alpha coincide when beta=0.


The key point is not merely q_phase*D_S=R. Equation(203.9) says the content exponent alpha is NEVER split partially between q_phase and D_S:
- if p divides q_phase, q_phase contains the full p^alpha content block;
- if p does not divide q_phase, D_S contains the full p^alpha content block.


Therefore min(alpha,v_p(q_phase)) is either alpha or0. This proves that gcd(H,q_phase) is a unitary divisor of H, and its unitary complement divides D_S.


3. Original full-S numerator bridge


Retained184/186 define


T=N_T/R^2,
S=2T=2N_T/R^2.                                 (203.10)


R is odd on the retained186 population. Hence


v_p(Den(S))=max(0,2lambda-v_p(N_T)).            (203.11)


Use the three rows above.


(A) Den(S) has p-depth0, so v_p(N_T)>=2lambda.
(B) Den(S) has p-depth2beta, so v_p(N_T)=2lambda-2beta=2alpha.
(C) Den(S) has p-depth2lambda, so v_p(N_T)=0.  (203.12)


For beta=0 the first two collapse to v_p(N_T)>=2alpha versus0.


Therefore at every p^alpha||H,


min(alpha,v_p(N_T))
=
min(alpha,v_p(q_phase))
is either alpha or0.                             (203.13)


Primewise multiplication gives the exact integer identity


gcd(H,|N_T|)=gcd(H,q_phase)=H_Q,                (203.14)


and H_Q is unitary in H.


This is not the202 k0-clearing gcd. N_T here is the actual original physical numerator e1*f1+e2*f2+e3*f3, and H is the physical content product. The equality comes from186's realized content valuation table.


4. Median-content ternary law


Now specialize to174's sorted median b. Let


p^alpha || b,
beta=v_p(tau).                                  (203.15)


Because the contents are pairwise coprime, p does not divide a or d. Hence from(203.1)


v_p(q_min)=beta,
v_p(D_min)=alpha+beta=lambda.                   (203.16)


Combining with(203.7)-(203.8), every median-content prime obeys the exact ternary law


v_p(q_phase) in { v_p(D_min), v_p(b), 0 },      (203.17)
v_p(D_S)     in { 0, v_p(q_min), v_p(D_min) }, (203.18)


with corresponding


v_p(c_u) in {
  2v_p(b)+3v_p(q_min),
  2v_p(b)+v_p(q_min),
  v_p(q_min)
}.                                               (203.19)


The rows are aligned in the displayed order. When v_p(q_min)=0, the first two rows coincide.


Thus b_Q in(203.5) is exactly the product of the full median prime-power blocks using rows(A)/(B), and b_S is exactly the product of the row(C) blocks.


5. Visible and hidden median components


From(203.5):


b_Q | q_phase,
b_Q^2 | c_u,                                    (203.20)


while


b_S | D_S,
b_S^2 | Den(S).                                 (203.21)


The two factors are coprime and b=b_Q*b_S.


Call b_Q the phase-visible median content and b_S the full-S-hidden median content.


The terminology describes the retained receiver only:
- on a visible prime, q_phase contains the full content exponent;
- on a hidden prime, q_phase contains NONE of the content exponent and c_u contains only the tau contribution beta. The entire alpha+beta denominator depth is absorbed by D_S.


In particular on a hidden median prime p^alpha||b_S,


v_p(q_phase)=0,
v_p(c_u)=v_p(q_min)=beta,
v_p(D_S)=v_p(D_min)=alpha+beta,
v_p(N_T)=0.                                     (203.22)


Thus neither q_phase nor the common-u denominator c_u sees the hidden content exponent alpha. The original S numerator is also a p-unit there. The content is present only through the full S denominator and the physical edge/content data.


This precisely identifies why186 conservation alone did not close the K>1 low-median multiplicity.


6. Scoped counting consequence for the visible branch


Retained186 proves for Z,D>=1


#E(c_u<=Z, q_phase>=D) <= (Z/D) B^o.           (203.23)


Since b_Q|q_phase, for every Y>=1,


#E(c_u<=Z, b_Q>=Y)
<= #E(c_u<=Z, q_phase>=Y)
<= (Z/Y) B^o.                                   (203.24)


This is a legitimate same-physical routing of a median-content condition into the existing186 summed tail. It is NOT an independent density saving and must not be multiplied by another q_phase tail.


The present residual does not provide a sufficiently small global cap Z on c_u, so(203.24) does not close the primary gate. It does show that any future threshold-specific c_u cap immediately controls the phase-visible part of the median content without paying a separate b_Q sum.


There is no corresponding retained upper tail for b_S: large b_S means large D_S and therefore SMALLER q_phase. Fixed-S results fix the full rational S, not only its denominator D_S. Hence the b_S branch remains the hard part.


7. Relation to low-median content budget and no-double-charge


176's general low-median outer budget counted sorted contents a<=b<=d with


b<=K,
b*d<=C,


at cost at most 6*C*min(K,sqrt(C)) before the active-tau measure.


203 does not remove that factor globally. Instead it decomposes its median label canonically into b_Q*b_S and proves:
- b_Q is already paid through q_phase/c_u when a usable186 tail applies;
- b_S cannot be charged to q_phase or c_u; it lives in D_S and must be attacked through full-S/original physical structure.


Do NOT:
- count H_Q^2|c_u and H_S^2|Den(S) as two independent square densities;
- multiply(203.24) by183 fixed-c_u fibers or174 fixed-D_min fibers as independent gains;
- identify q_min with q_phase;
- assume b_S is small because q_phase is large; it is the complementary large-D_S branch;
- treat the three local rows as probabilistically independent across primes.


The router is exact structure, not a density model.


8. NEXT204


Restrict the unresolved K>1 low-median attack to the full-S-hidden median component b_S.


Use the exact row(C) conditions(203.22):
for every p^alpha||b_S with beta=v_p(tau),


v_p(N_T)=0,
v_p(D_S)=alpha+beta,
v_p(q_phase)=0,
v_p(c_u)=beta.


Attack whether the simultaneous original conditions
N_T=e1*f1+e2*f2+e3*f3,
the three primitive space triangles D_i=tau*c_i,
134 four-square/intrinsic-R lift,
171 large-Sigma,
174 large-D_min,
and pairwise-coprime contents
force a summed bound on occupied b_S or on its product with q_min.


The needed theorem must control moving D_S while keeping the FULL rational S/original numerator data; generic square-divisor sparsity is already paid by186 and is not progress.


If the hidden branch again admits every content depth without a cross-prime/global restriction, record that firewall and move to the separate large-c threshold branch. Do not restart K1-only177–181 or the134-superseded fresh-C_u route.


Gate OPEN; global credit0. 200 small-W disposal and all previous scoped sectors retained. Physical endpoints enumerated=0.


9. Verification and audit scope


The proof is a direct specialization of the exact186 partial/saturated content depth tables, together with the retained ROUTE6/7 identities
D_i=tau*c_i, R=H*tau, pairwise-coprime h_i,
174's sorted-content identities(174.7), and S=2N_T/R^2.


Primewise checks:
- beta>0: substituting lambda=alpha+beta into all three186 rows gives(203.7),(203.12),(203.17)-(203.19);
- beta=0: the saturated two rows agree with the collapsed formulas.
Thus(203.14) and the unitary-divisor statement hold at every prime of H.


Within-session exact symbolic/deductive review PASS. Independent hostile audit NOT RUN. Separate-chat audit162–185 remains the only independent audit scope. No retraction, closure or global-credit flag change.

records.title: M3-T11-202 — Original-phase homogeneity cancellation and conductor-support firewall
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-202 — Original-phase homogeneity cancellation and conductor-support firewall


STATUS: PROVED_ORIGINAL_PHASE_K0_HOMOGENEITY / PROVED_FORCED_CLEARED_GCD_POWERS / PROVED_K1_CONDUCTOR_SUPPORT_FIREWALL / DIRECT_K0_PHASE_ROUTE_NO_NEW_SAVING / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
Authority: Stage37 MAIN, operational CARD-INDEX, short RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE only as needed, latest201 with dependencies192/196/186/184. Gate OPEN. NEXT203. Independent hostile audit NOT RUN; separate-chat audit162–185 scope unchanged. TI parked;120 retracted;147–149 frozen. No retraction.


1. Result and scope


201 proved that the normalized196 two-point receiver and186 denominator conservation are blind to the halfpoint normalization scale k0. NEXT202 asked whether returning BEFORE that normalization to the ORIGINAL phase polynomials
U,V,N_T,G_phase
could recover a non-homogeneous k0 or ell_lost=g/d relation.


It does not. The original phase polynomials are exactly homogeneous in the192 cleared receiver:
U,V have degree3 in the physical edge/diagonal coordinates and N_T has degree2. Clearing the common k0 denominator therefore inserts forced powers k0^3 and k0^2. Those powers disappear exactly in G_phase reduction and in Den(S). Thus the original product/common-u phase is also normalization-scale blind.


A second exact firewall holds on K=1: d and ell_lost=g/d divide g while gcd(g,R)=1, so they are p-units at every conductor prime p|R. They cannot contribute any gcd support to s or v, which divide R. Moreover the R-supported valuations of k0 are exactly the R-supported valuations of N_y. Hence196.9 merely transports the already-known shared N_y conductor to k0; it does not control the remaining conductor depth.


This is a route obstruction, not a proof that actual endpoints with freely varying k0 exist and not a global large-W disposal. 200's small-W sector remains the only W counting credit in this branch; global credit remains0.


2. Exact cleared receiver for the ORIGINAL phase


Use192's signed physical reconstruction. Let epsilon_i in {+1,-1} be the retained original diagonal signs and define integer cleared coordinates


E1=D0*A,
E2=D0*F,
E3=W,


F1=epsilon1*L1,
F2=epsilon2*L2,
F3=epsilon3*D0*n_face.                       (202.1)


Because
D0=k0*g,
W=k0*e3,
L1=k0*|f1|,
L2=k0*|f2|,
D0*n_face=k0*|f3|,
the actual signed coordinates are


e_i=E_i/k0,
f_i=F_i/k0,
R=L/k0.                                      (202.2)


Define the cleared original phase polynomials


U0=E1*E2*E3-E1*F2*F3-E2*F1*F3-E3*F1*F2,
V0=F1*E2*E3+F2*E1*E3+F3*E1*E2-F1*F2*F3,
N0=E1*F1+E2*F2+E3*F3.                        (202.3)


Using192's ORIGINAL definitions


U=e1*e2*e3-e1*f2*f3-e2*f1*f3-e3*f1*f2,
V=f1*e2*e3+f2*e1*e3+f3*e1*e2-f1*f2*f3,
N_T=e1*f1+e2*f2+e3*f3,


we get identically


U0=k0^3*U,
V0=k0^3*V,
N0=k0^2*N_T.                                 (202.4)


No valuation or existence argument is involved; these are pure homogeneous substitutions.


3. The apparent k0^3 in the phase gcd is forced and cancels


Let
G_phase=gcd(U,V)>0,
G0=gcd(U0,V0)>0.
From(202.4),


G0=k0^3*G_phase.                              (202.5)


Thus every p-adic factor 3*v_p(k0) seen in the cleared gcd G0 is forced solely by clearing the common coordinate denominator. It is NOT a new phase collision or selector.


192 reduces the actual phase by


b_phi=U/G_phase,
a_phi=V/G_phase,
c_phase=R^3/G_phase.


Substituting(202.2),(202.5) gives the exact cleared formulas


b_phi=U0/G0,
a_phi=V0/G0,
c_phase=L^3/G0.                              (202.6)


Therefore k0 disappears completely from the reduced product phase. On the physical population c_phase is the same actual reduced product/common-u phase coordinate routed downstream to the184/186 phase analysis; no extra k0 divisibility may be charged.


Equivalently, under the common normalization scaling
(E_i,F_i,L,k0) -> (lambda E_i,lambda F_i,lambda L,lambda k0),
U0,V0,G0 scale by lambda^3 while every reduced phase coordinate in(202.6) is invariant.


4. N_T and Den(S): the apparent k0^2 also cancels


184/186 use


T=sum_i (e_i/R)(f_i/R)=N_T/R^2,
S=2T.


By(202.2),(202.4),


T=N0/L^2,
S=2N0/L^2.                                   (202.7)


Hence the reduced denominator is


Den(S)=L^2/gcd(L^2,2N0).                     (202.8)


But
L^2=k0^2 R^2,
2N0=2k0^2 N_T,
so


gcd(L^2,2N0)=k0^2*gcd(R^2,2N_T),             (202.9)


and therefore


Den(S)=R^2/gcd(R^2,2N_T).                    (202.10)


Again every k0^2 visible before reduction is forced and cancels exactly. The186 square denominator D_S^2=Den(S), q_phase=R/D_S, and
H_content*c_u*Den(S)=R^3
therefore receive no new k0 resource from the192 cleared receiver.


Do NOT count k0^2|gcd(L^2,2N0) or k0^3|G0 as fresh divisibility conditions. They are identities caused by homogeneous clearing.


5. The lost factor has disjoint conductor support


192 proves
gcd(R,g)=1,
d|g,
ell_lost:=g/d,
and
k0*ell_lost=2N_y.                            (202.11)


Therefore


gcd(R,d)=gcd(R,ell_lost)=1.                  (202.12)


On the retained186 population R is odd. For every prime p|R, p does not divide 2*ell_lost, so(202.11) gives the exact valuation identity


v_p(k0)=v_p(N_y), for every p|R.              (202.13)


Consequently, for every divisor r|R,


gcd(k0,r)=gcd(N_y,r).                         (202.14)


This is a useful exact transfer, but it does not create a new saving.


On K=1,196 writes s*v=R, gcd(s,v)=1 and proves


gcd(N_y,s)=gcd(|A-eta*F|,s),
gcd(N_y,v)=gcd(|A+eta*F|,v).                 (202.15)


Combining(202.14),(202.15),


gcd(k0,s)=gcd(|A-eta*F|,s),
gcd(k0,v)=gcd(|A+eta*F|,v).                  (202.16)


Meanwhile(202.12) gives


gcd(d,s)=gcd(d,v)=1,
gcd(ell_lost,s)=gcd(ell_lost,v)=1.           (202.17)


Thus the proposed202 alternative "use d or ell_lost to control the unshared conductor" has no gcd support at all: d and ell_lost are units at every prime of s*v=R. The only k0 conductor sharing is exactly the already-known N_y sharing from196.9. Any excess conductor valuation beyond that shared part remains OPEN.


This does not rule out a genuinely new non-gcd congruence involving d or ell_lost, but no retained theorem supplies one.


6. Combined firewall for the large-W route


The following apparent routes are now closed as NEW-saving sources unless an additional non-homogeneous theorem is introduced:


(a) normalized196: closed by201 because W/H and WB_T/H^3 cancel k0;
(b) original U,V,G_phase: closed by(202.4)-(202.6), where k0^3 is forced clearing content;
(c) original N_T/Den(S): closed by(202.7)-(202.10), where k0^2 is forced clearing content;
(d) K1 conductor gcd via d or ell_lost: closed by(202.12),(202.17);
(e) K1 conductor gcd via k0: reduces exactly to196.9 through(202.13)-(202.16).


Accordingly, existing192/196/184/186 identities do not force a large k0 component of
W=k0*e3
to consume the phase denominator/conductor resource. Large W remains an OPEN actual-receiver residual. This result only prevents repeated work on an algebraically homogeneous coupling.


No statement here says k0 is freely scalable among actual primitive endpoints; the receiver variables satisfy the full192 quartic and original masks. The theorem is only that the current phase reductions cannot distinguish the common normalization scale.


7. No-double-charge rules


Do not:
- use k0^3|G0 as a fresh gcd probability or divisor saving;
- use k0^2|gcd(L^2,2N0) as a fresh Den(S) selector;
- multiply fixed-W200 by fixed-c_u183, fixed-N_y192, fixed-Phi195 or fixed-Theta196 fibers;
- claim d or ell_lost shares conductor primes with s or v;
- reinterpret(202.16) as a new K1 condition independent of196.9.


All are exact consequences of the same physical endpoint data.


8. NEXT203 — return to the K>1 low-median gate


Per201's fallback rule, the direct large-W/phase coupling has now been exhausted through both normalized and original phase coordinates. Return to the separate all-content low-median problem that remained OPEN in174-176.


Work on the surviving exact physical population with:
- large Sigma from171,
- large D_min from174,
- h_middle>1 (the K>1 branch left outside176-180's unit-median K=1 development),
- all original Gaussian/triple-spin/four-square/intrinsic-R masks,
- and186 full-content conservation
  H_content*c_u*D_S^2=R^3,
  c_u=tau*q_phase^2.


The first target is a SAME-PHYSICAL summed receiver that pays the moving median-content multiplicity rather than fixing q_min. Use174's
D_min=q_min*h_middle
with q_min kept distinct from186 q_phase. Seek a content-prime relation between h_middle or D_min and D_S/q_phase/c_u, or prove a new firewall if their valuation tables are independent after exact content allocation.


Do not restart the K1-only fresh-conductor chain177-181, do not use fixed-q_min B^o (not proved), and do not revive the134-superseded fresh amplified C_u branch.


Gate OPEN; global credit0. 200 small-W disposal retained. Physical endpoints enumerated=0.


9. Verification and audit scope


(202.4)-(202.10) are exact symbolic homogeneous substitutions into the retained192/184/186 definitions.
(202.12)-(202.17) follow from retained192 gcd(R,g)=1, d|g, k0*ell_lost=2N_y, retained186 odd R, and retained196 K1 split.


Within-session exact symbolic/deductive review PASS. No independent hostile audit was run. Separate-chat audit162-185 remains the only independent audit scope. No retraction, authority, closure or global-credit flag changes.

records.title: M3-T11-201 — Normalization-scale cancellation firewall for large intrinsic W
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-201 — Normalization-scale cancellation firewall for large intrinsic W


STATUS: PROVED_NORMALIZATION_SCALE_CANCELLATION / EXISTING_186_RESOURCE_BLIND_TO_K0 / LARGE_W_DIRECT_COUPLING_FIREWALL / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
Authority: Stage37 MAIN, operational CARD-INDEX, short RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE only as needed, latest200 with dependencies192/196/186. Gate OPEN. NEXT202. Independent hostile audit NOT RUN; separate-chat audit162–185 scope unchanged. TI parked;120 retracted;147–149 frozen. No retraction.


1. Question attacked


200 leaves the actual population with large intrinsic W. NEXT201 asked whether
W=k0 e3,
k0=gcd(L,D0),
D0=2N_y d,
g/d=2N_y/k0
can be combined directly with196's pair receiver and186's
H_content*c_u*Den(S)=R^3,
c_u=tau*q_phase^2
to force large W to consume an already conserved phase/content denominator resource.


The answer from the currently retained identities is NO: the normalization scale k0 cancels exactly from every196 normalized elliptic coordinate, while186 is a theorem in the reconstructed primitive physical variables R,e_i,h_i and phase data and contains no k0. Therefore the proposed direct large-W -> large-q_phase/Den(S)/c_u inference is unavailable without one genuinely new cross-relation involving k0 (equivalently N_y/(g/d)).


This is a route firewall, not a counterexample to a stronger unknown theorem.


2. Exact cancellation in the196 receiver


From192:
L=k0 R,
D0=k0 g,
W=k0 e3.                                      (201.1)


From196:
G=kappa H^2,
Phi=L/H,
hence
H=L/Phi=k0 R/Phi.                            (201.2)


Therefore
W/H=(k0 e3)/(k0 R/Phi)=e3 Phi/R.             (201.3)


The negative point of196 becomes
P_minus=(-(W/H)^2,-W B_T/H^3).
Using B_T=k0^2 T from196.4 gives
W B_T/H^3
=(k0 e3)(k0^2 T)/(k0^3 R^3/Phi^3)
=e3 T Phi^3/R^3.                             (201.4)


Thus
P_minus=(-(e3 Phi/R)^2,-e3 T Phi^3/R^3),     (201.5)
with NO k0.


Likewise the positive point
P_plus=(Phi^2,kappa Phi p)
and curve
E_Theta: Y^2=X^3-Theta^2 X,
Theta=kappa q,
contain no k0 once the physical pair phase is reduced. The common-curve two-point incidence therefore cannot see whether W is large because k0 is large.


The integer identities also homogenize:
B_Q=k0^2 Q,
B_P=k0^2 P,
B_T=k0^2 T,
L=k0 R,
W=k0 e3.
Hence
B_Q^2+B_P^2=L^4
and
B_Q^2-B_T^2=W^4
reduce exactly to
Q^2+P^2=R^4,
Q^2-T^2=e3^4.                                (201.6)
Again k0 disappears.


3. 186 conservation is intrinsically k0-blind


186 defines, on the actual primitive physical endpoint,
H_content=h1 h2 h3,
tau=R/H_content,
c_u=Den(w1 w2 w3),
t=Den(S)=D_S^2,
q_phase=R/D_S,
and proves
H_content*c_u*t=R^3,
c_u=tau*q_phase^2.                            (201.7)


Every quantity in(201.7) is computed after192 reconstructs the primitive physical endpoint. None uses the halfpoint normalization gcd k0, the reduced halfpoint denominator d, or N_y. Substituting L=k0R and D0=k0g into192 does not insert k0 into(201.7).


Consequently the conjunction of(201.1)–(201.7) supplies no inequality of the form
large k0 => large q_phase,
large k0 => large Den(S),
large k0 => small c_u,
or any other phase-resource consumption.
Any such implication would require an additional theorem relating k0 to the original common-phase numerator/denominator data.


4. The lost-factor identity does not repair the gap


192 gives exactly
ell_lost:=g/d=2N_y/k0,
so
k0=2N_y/ell_lost.                            (201.8)


Therefore
W=2N_y e3/ell_lost.                          (201.9)


This is useful bookkeeping, but retained inputs do not relate ell_lost or N_y to q_phase, D_S or c_u beyond the already known endpoint correspondence/fibers. In particular fixed-N_y192 and fixed-c_u183 are alternate B^o fibers on the SAME endpoint set and cannot be multiplied as independent savings.


Thus large W can be decomposed as a product/quotient among moving labels N_y,e3,ell_lost, but the current theorem set contains no summed cross-bound that charges one of those factors to186's conserved denominator budget.


5. K=1 full-pair gcd split is also only shared-factor information


196.9 gives on the unit-pair branch
gcd(N_y,s)=gcd(|A-eta F|,s),
gcd(N_y,v)=gcd(|A+eta F|,v),
with sv=R and gcd(s,v)=1.                     (201.10)


This determines the portions of s,v shared with N_y. It does not control the coprime/unshared portions of s or v. Combining(201.8) with(201.10) therefore cannot bound k0 or W unless one proves new information about the unshared conductor or about ell_lost.


This matches196's own stated limitation and is not a new density condition.


6. Formal firewall


Let I be the set of retained algebraic identities consisting only of192.7–192.10,196.4–196.9 and186.7/conservation, together with their definitions. After replacing
(L,D0,W,B_Q,B_P,B_T,H)
by
(k0 R,k0 g,k0 e3,k0^2 Q,k0^2 P,k0^2 T,k0 R/Phi),
every normalized196 equation and every186 equation is independent of k0; the only surviving k0 occurrence is the192 halfpoint normalization relation(201.8).


Therefore I alone cannot produce a direct monotone resource inequality charging large W through k0 to q_phase,Den(S),c_u. A productive continuation must add an equation/congruence not invariant under this normalization-scale cancellation.


This statement is deliberately scoped. It does NOT assert that k0 is freely scalable among actual primitive endpoints, and it does NOT prove statistical independence. It only proves that the proposed derivation from the presently retained identities is algebraically underdetermined.


7. Consequence for route selection


Do not continue201 by:
- substituting W=k0 e3 into P_minus and treating k0 as a new elliptic height cost;
- combining fixed-W200 with fixed-c183/fixed-N_y192/fixed-Phi195/fixed-Theta196 as independent density;
- reusing186 conservation to claim large W forces large q_phase;
- using196.9 shared gcd laws to cap the unshared conductor.


All of those miss the exact cancellation above.


8. NEXT202


The next useful target is now narrower: find a NON-homogeneous cross-relation involving k0 or ell_lost=g/d and an original phase quantity before normalization erases k0.


Priority interfaces:
(a) substitute the192 exact integer reconstruction directly into ORIGINAL
U,V,N_T and G_phase=gcd(U,V), rather than the normalized196 elliptic coordinates, and seek a primewise relation between k0 or ell_lost and G_phase/Den(S);
(b) on K=1, attack the unshared parts of s,v in196.10 by a congruence involving d or ell_lost, not merely N_y;
(c) if (a),(b) again cancel, record the obstruction and return to the separate K>1 large-c/low-median averaging gate.


A productive202 must exhibit a relation that is not homogeneous under
(L,D0,W,B_*) -> (k0 L0,k0 D00,k0 W0,k0^2 B_*0)
and then pay all moving labels in a summed physical bound.


Gate OPEN; global credit0. 200 small-W disposal retained. No physical endpoints enumerated.


9. Verification and audit scope


Equations(201.3)–(201.6) are direct symbolic substitutions into the exact192/196 formulas. Equation(201.7) is the retained186 theorem. Equation(201.8) is retained192.10. No numerical existence assumption is used.


Within-session exact symbolic/deductive review PASS. Independent hostile audit NOT RUN. Separate-chat audit162–185 remains the only independent audit scope. No retraction or authority change.

records.title: M3-T11-200 — All-content fixed-W divisor fiber and small intrinsic-W sector
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-200 — All-content fixed-W divisor fiber and small intrinsic-W sector


STATUS: PROVED_ALL_CONTENT_FIXED_W_DIVISOR_FIBER / PROVED_SMALL_INTRINSIC_W_SUM / ACTUAL_INTEGER_RECEIVER / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
Authority: Stage37 MAIN, operational CARD-INDEX, short RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE §17.3–17.4, latest199 with actual-receiver dependencies196 and192. Gate OPEN. NEXT201. Independent hostile audit NOT RUN; separate-chat audit162–185 scope unchanged. TI parked;120 retracted;147–149 frozen. No retraction.


1. Result and scope


Return from199's pre-third-face relaxation to the actual192/196 integer receiver. The key point is that196 contains TWO nested integer difference-of-squares factorizations:
B_Q^2-B_T^2=W^4,
B_Q^2+B_P^2=L^4.
The first fixes the pair-phase trace data divisor-theoretically from W; the second fixes L and B_P divisor-theoretically from B_Q. Then192's
W^2=L^2-n_face^2 D0^2
returns to the original integer full-lift receiver.


This yields a new all-content fixed-W endpoint fiber:
m_W(w;B) <= B^{o(1)}
uniformly for every positive occupied integer w of polynomial height. Consequently
#E(W<=Z) <= Z B^{o(1)}.
In particular W<=B^(1/3-epsilon_W), fixed epsilon_W>0, is o(M3) on the retained B^(1/3) benchmark.


This is a genuine actual-receiver theorem, unlike199. It is nevertheless only a scoped small-W disposal. Large W remains open, so global counting credit stays0.


2. First divisor reconstruction: W fixes B_Q and B_T up to divisor-many choices


For an actual physical point196 gives
B_Q^2-B_T^2=W^4,
hence
C_-:=B_Q-B_T,
C_+:=B_Q+B_T,
C_- C_+=W^4.


Fix W=w>0. Every signed ordered pair (C_-,C_+) is chosen from the integer divisors of w^4, with the necessary same-parity condition. Then
B_Q=(C_++C_-)/2,
B_T=(C_+-C_-)/2.
Thus the number of possible signed (B_Q,B_T) is O(tau(w^4)), up to an absolute sign factor. Zero/degenerate values are rejected by the retained physical masks.


No local density is used: this is exact integer factorization of196.5.


3. Second divisor reconstruction: B_Q fixes L and B_P up to divisor-many choices


The other196 identity is
B_Q^2+B_P^2=L^4.
Write
E_-:=L^2-B_P,
E_+:=L^2+B_P.
Then
E_- E_+=B_Q^2.


For fixed B_Q, choose a signed ordered factor pair of B_Q^2 with the required parity. It gives
L^2=(E_++E_-)/2,
B_P=(E_+-E_-)/2.
Require L^2 to be a positive perfect square and take L>0. Hence there are O(tau(B_Q^2)) possibilities for (L,B_P). Again this is a reconstruction identity, not an independent square-density charge.


On physical points W<L because L^2-W^2=(n_face D0)^2>0.


4. Return to192: L and W recover the face-scale product


Define
K_face=sqrt(L^2-W^2).
Require L^2-W^2 to be a positive square. On an actual endpoint
K_face=n_face D0.


Choose a positive divisor n_face|K_face and set
D0=K_face/n_face.
Require D0 even. The primitive face satisfies
A^2+F^2=n_face^2,
gcd(A,F)=1,
A odd, F even
under192's canonical routing. For fixed n_face the number of primitive Pythagorean representations (A,F) is divisor-many, O(tau(n_face^2)) and in particular B^{o(1)} at polynomial height.


Next192 has
D0=2 N_y d.
Choose N_y*d=D0/2. There are at most tau(D0/2) positive choices. For each (N_y,d,A,F,L),192.5 requires
X^2=L+A^2 F^2 d^4.
Require the right side to be a positive square; then X is uniquely determined.


Now form
J0=X,
J1=X-A^2 d^2,
J2=X-F^2 d^2
and require all192 reduced/gcd conditions and
N_y^2=J0 J1 J2.
These are checks, not new summation variables.


Finally set
k0=gcd(L,D0),
g=D0/k0,
R=L/k0,
e3=W/k0,
e1=gA,
e2=gF,
L1=X^2-2A^2 X d^2+A^2F^2d^4,
L2=X^2-2F^2 X d^2+A^2F^2d^4,
and require k0|L1,L2. This recovers the physical diagonals exactly as192.8. Recompute all h_i/content, signs,196 B_Q,B_P,B_T, the original U,V,N_T/Den(S),134 four-square/intrinsic-R masks, canonical routing and positivity. Remaining tests only discard candidates.


Therefore a fixed W has only divisor-many physical preimages across ALL faces, contents, denominators and phase labels. No outer h, kappa, Theta or Phi cost appears.


5. Uniform fiber bound and polynomial height


For R<=B, e3<=R<=B and W=k0 e3. From192,
k0<=D0=2N_y d,
N_y<8B^3,
d|g<=R<=B.
Hence W<16B^5. All reconstructed integers B_Q,B_T,L,D0,n_face,N_y,d,X are bounded by fixed powers of B once W is fixed and the physical R<=B tests are imposed. Standard divisor estimates therefore absorb every factor count into B^{o(1)}.


Uniformly on the canonical physical population,
m_W(w;B)
:=#{primitive canonical original endpoints R<=B with intrinsic receiver W=w}
<=B^{o(1)}.


The proof is elementary integer factorization. It does not invoke uniform elliptic rational-point bounds, Mordell-Weil rank, Kummer density, or the five197 elliptic factors.


Summing the fixed-W fibers gives, for Z>=1,
#E(W<=Z)<=Z B^{o(1)}.


Thus for every fixed epsilon_W>0,
#E(W<=B^(1/3-epsilon_W))=o(B^(1/3))
at the retained M3 comparison scale. This is a scoped new sector disposal. It is not a claim that the surviving residual has small W.


6. Relation to earlier coordinates and no-double-charge rules


W is192's intrinsic integer quartic-square root, not the rational z of197/199 and not an independently chosen negative elliptic point. On physical points e3=W/k0, but k0 moves; therefore the fixed-W theorem is not merely a fixed-edge theorem.


The nested factorizations are already consequences of the same physical receiver. Do NOT multiply the W-fiber saving by fixed-Theta196, fixed-Phi195, fixed-N_y192 or fixed-c183 fibers as independent densities. They are alternate bounded-fiber coordinates on the same endpoint set.


The theorem does not cap the occupied W support in the large-W residual. Since W may be as large as a fixed power of B, the trivial full support is far too large. It also does not solve K=1 unshared conductor or K>1 large-c/low-median averaging.


7. NEXT201


Restrict henceforth to the surviving actual population
W>B^(1/3-epsilon_W)
for any chosen fixed epsilon_W>0, together with the previously retained large-Phi/Theta and large-c/full-S residual conditions.


Seek a same-physical relation forcing a large W to consume one of the already conserved denominator/content resources, rather than treating W as an independent large label. The most concrete interfaces are:
- W=k0 e3 with k0=gcd(L,D0), D0=2N_y d and192 lost factor g/d=2N_y/k0;
-196 G=kappa H^2, Phi=L/H and P_minus=(-W^2/H^2,-W B_T/H^3);
-186 H_content*c_u*Den(S)=R^3 with c_u=tau q_phase^2;
-196 K=1 split gcd(N_y,s)=gcd(|A-eta F|,s), gcd(N_y,R/s)=gcd(|A+eta F|,R/s).


A productive201 must turn one of these into a summed occupied-support/correlation bound on LARGE W, with moving content and conductor costs paid. Fixed-W, fixed-N_y, fixed-Phi, fixed-Theta, fixed-c and199 rank arguments cannot be recharged.


Gate OPEN; global credit0. Restart from200 ->196/192 ->186 and only necessary ROUTE17 sections. Full history unnecessary.


8. Verification and audit scope


The proof is direct divisor reconstruction from exact identities already verified in192/196. Algebraic replay:
(C_-C_+=W^4) gives B_Q,B_T and B_Q^2-B_T^2=W^4 identically;
(E_-E_+=B_Q^2) gives L^2,B_P and B_Q^2+B_P^2=L^4 identically;
K_face^2=L^2-W^2 and K_face=n_face D0 return exactly to192.6.
All subsequent reconstruction formulas are192.4–192.8.


Within-session deductive review PASS. No physical endpoints enumerated. Independent hostile audit NOT RUN. Separate-chat audit162–185 scope unchanged. No authority/credit/closure flag retracted.

records.title: M3-T11-199 — Moving cyclic-coset family and third-face nonforcing firewall
records.content:
﻿M3-T11-199 — Moving cyclic-coset family and third-face nonforcing firewall


STATUS: PROVED_MOVING_CYCLIC_COSET_FAMILY / FUNCTION_FIELD_THIRD_FACE_NONSQUARE / INFINITE_P29_FAILURE_SUBFAMILY / PRE_THIRD_FACE_RANK_INDEPENDENCE_FIREWALL / GLOBAL_COUNTING_CREDIT=0.
Authority: Stage37 MAIN, operational CARD-INDEX, short RESULT-LEDGER, active ROUTE §17.3–17.4, latest M3-T11-198 with dependencies196–197 and192. No historical full reread. Gate OPEN. NEXT200. Independent hostile audit NOT RUN; separate-chat audit162–185 scope unchanged. TI parked;120 retracted;147–149 frozen. No retraction.


1. Result and scope


M3-T11-198 proved that every physical pair lies in one full-2 Kummer coset
P_- = P_+ + T_(0) + [2]Q_aux
on E_Theta, and supplied one exact positive partial-sphere witness with Q_aux=2P showing that this coset neither forces a second independent Mordell–Weil class nor the third face.


The present card upgrades that single witness to an exact moving one-parameter family over Q(rho), and then to infinitely many positive rational specializations for which the two adjacent faces and sphere hold but the third face provably fails by one fixed local obstruction modulo29.


This is a negative/firewall theorem for the PRE-THIRD-FACE relaxation only. It does not construct original endpoints, does not remove192's integer n_face/W condition, and earns no counting credit. In particular it does not say the actual192 receiver has many failures: on that receiver197 already shows the third face is encoded by integer n_face/W.


2. Generic cyclic-coset family


Work on the normalized congruent-number curve
E_a: y^2=x^3-a^2 x,
with
a=(1-rho^2)/(1+rho^2),  b=2rho/(1+rho^2),
so a^2+b^2=1. Put
P=(1,b),  T_(0)=(0,0),
Q_aux=2P,
P_-=P+T_(0)+[2]Q_aux=5P+T_(0).


Thus for every rho away from finitely many poles and degeneracies, P and P_- lie in the subgroup generated by P and rational 2-torsion. No rank>=2 or Mordell–Weil independence can be inferred from this two-point configuration.


Let x(P_-)=-z^2. Define the common denominator polynomial
K=(1+rho^2)
  (rho^4-2rho^3+2rho+1)
  (rho^4+2rho^3-2rho+1)
  (rho^16+16rho^14+20rho^12-16rho^10-26rho^8-16rho^6+20rho^4+16rho^2+1).


Exact group-law simplification gives z=Z/K up to sign, where
Z=(1-rho^2)
  (rho^4-2rho^3+4rho^2-2rho+1)
  (rho^4+2rho^3+4rho^2+2rho+1)
  (rho^8-4rho^7+4rho^5-6rho^4+4rho^3-4rho+1)
  (rho^8+4rho^7-4rho^5-6rho^4-4rho^3+4rho+1).


The two 197 adjacent-face square roots are themselves rational functions:
S=
  2rho (rho^8-2rho^4+5)
  (rho^16+52rho^12-26rho^8-12rho^4+1)/K,


D=
  2rho (5rho^8-2rho^4+1)
  (rho^16-12rho^12-26rho^8+52rho^4+1)/K.


Consequently
S^2=(1+a)(1-z^2/a),
D^2=(1-a)(1+z^2/a)
identically in Q(rho). With
xi_1=(S+D)/2, xi_2=(S-D)/2, xi_3=z,
the 197 inverse formulas recover the two adjacent signed face diagonals rationally. This is therefore a genuine rational one-parameter family on the sphere/two-face relaxation, not isolated points obtained by numerical search.


The identity is exactly the M3-T11-198 Kummer coset specialized to Q_aux=2P. The family introduces no new selector and no independent density.


3. The third face is nontrivial over Q(rho)


The missing face condition is t^2=1-z^2. Exact factorization yields


1-z^2 = 4 rho^2 F(rho) G(rho) / K(rho)^2,


where
F=rho^24-22rho^20+235rho^16-228rho^12+39rho^8+26rho^4+13,


G=13rho^24+26rho^20+39rho^16-228rho^12+235rho^8-22rho^4+1.


This rational function is NOT a square in Q(rho). A proof avoiding any irreducibility assumption is specialization: at rho=2/3,


1-z^2 =
866736819585661308486471504 /
968950048335398046518197129,


whose numerator has v_101=1 while the denominator is a square at101. Hence the value is not a rational square. If 1-z^2 were a square in Q(rho), every defined rational specialization would be a rational square, contradiction.


Thus the third-face quadratic extension is genuinely nontrivial on this moving cyclic-coset family. The full-2 Kummer coset and the fact that P_- is obtained from P by translated doubling do not algebraically force the third face.


4. Infinite positive rational failure subfamily via p=29


At rho=2/3 one has
a=5/13, b=12/13,
z^2=102213228749736738031725625/968950048335398046518197129,
S^2=973655520349960422880214544/968950048335398046518197129,
D^2=759818118821362194092728464/968950048335398046518197129.


Hence 0<z<1 and S>D>0. Positivity is open, so it persists for all rational rho in a sufficiently small real neighborhood of2/3 avoiding the finitely many poles.


Modulo29, rho=2/3 is rho=20 and direct reduction of the exact rational function gives
1-z^2 == 17 (mod29).
The denominator is a29-adic unit there, and 17 is a quadratic nonresidue because 17^14 == -1 (mod29).


For any integer N with 29 not dividing N put
rho_N=2/3+29/N.
Then rho_N==2/3 (mod29). For all sufficiently large positive N, rho_N is in the above positive real neighborhood and avoids the finitely many poles. Therefore 1-z(rho_N)^2 remains a29-adic unit with residue17, so it cannot be a rational square.


There are infinitely many such N. After clearing common denominators of the rational xi_i and the two adjacent face diagonals and dividing their gcd, each gives a positive primitive integral partial sphere with two integral adjacent face diagonals and nonintegral third face diagonal. These are pre-third-face states, not perfect-cuboid endpoints.


This strengthens198's one witness to an infinite explicitly routed family. It also prevents the objection that the cyclic dependence seen in198 might have been an isolated specialization.


5. What this closes and what it does not


Closed as a method:
- No argument may infer two independent Mordell–Weil points merely from the196/198 pair P_+,P_- or from the full-2 Kummer coset.
- No argument may claim the translated-doubling graph alone forces the third face.
